title: Shader Cycler
description: Add-on to oculus/iris to switch between shaders automatically when entering dimensions (including modded ones) or with just a key-bind
body:
#
🟢 Melon Shader Cycler
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
‎
###
Info
Melon Shader Cycler is a lightweight client-side Forge mod for Minecraft that lets you instantly switch between shaderpacks with a single keypress. It also supports switching shaders based on your current dimension, including modded dimensions. Designed with performance and immersion in mind, it’s perfect for players who use Oculus and want quick control over their shader setup.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
‎
